$comment: The Home hub's design tokens, the one source for the hub (web/src/index.css) and the desk panels (panels/firmware/main/tokens.h). Edit here, then run `node tokens/build.mjs`. A value is a string, or { value, note } where the note becomes a comment.

canvas.note: page background and sidebar: near-black, under a faint grain and one violet glow

panel.note: what a page's content fades into (the composer, a cook layer); the page itself since M38

card.note: a cell: flat, a hairline edge (line-soft), no sheen

line-strong.note: the edge of a field, an off switch, a tick to give

faint.note: 4.5:1 on cards, controls and glass tiles

accent.note: filled accent (buttons, toggles), white text at 4.8:1

violet.note: the brand violet (plan section 1), for glows and tints

cook.note: recipes: cook phases and the heat (prep phases are accent-fg)

glass.note: glass surfaces inside cards (tiles, chips), as on the desk panels

track.note: the unfilled part of a ring, arc or meter

label.note: small capitals, pills, badges; the smallest text in the hub

small.note: meta lines, card titles, secondary text

title.note: a name or headline inside a card; reading text

hero.note: the largest figures (the Air card's temperature, a run's distance)

mark.note: bars, LEDs, small marks in a chart

tag.note: tags, badges, a ticker, an option inside a control

control.note: buttons, fields, segmented controls, rows you tap

tile.note: tiles and boxes inside a card

fine.note: the least a control is to hit with a mouse (WCAG 2.2, 2.5.8)

coarse.note: the least a control is to hit with a finger

panel.$comment: Colours the desk panels use beside the shared ones, tuned for their IPS screens (true black behind). Only in tokens.h.

cell.note: a cell's face in a hairline grid (M38)

hairline.note: the 2px lines between cells: 1px is 0.1 mm on these screens
